title: Entryway
prompt: a realistic cutaway entryway, seen from a high camera raised above the furniture looking down at about 45 degrees so the tops of the furniture and the whole floor layout are clearly readable: a plain warm-grey back wall with a white baseboard across the upper part of the image and a light oak plank floor in the lower part, no side walls, no ceiling, no doors, no corner. A shoe cabinet against the back wall at the left with a key hook mounted on the wall above it, an entryway bench against the back wall in the middle, a coat rack standing at the right, an umbrella stand on the floor beside the coat rack with one umbrella standing in it, a door mat on the floor in front of the shoe cabinet. Every piece fully visible and entirely inside the frame with empty margin on every side, wide clear gaps, nothing floats, no object hides another. Parallel projection, no vanishing point, consistent scale, every object drawn at the same size whether near or far, true-to-life materials and colors, warm-grey and beige palette, no extra objects, no people, no text
